title: AS2 compiler: loadMovie() and loadMovieNum() push url and target in wrong order
description:
In packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts, the loadMovie() and loadMovieNum() builtins push their stack arguments in the wrong order for ActionGetURL2 (0x9A).

Ruffle's action_get_url_2 pops target_val FIRST (from top of stack), then url_val SECOND (below). So the correct stack layout is [url (deeper), target (top)].

Current loadMovie implementation:
  compileExpr(args[1])  // target — pushed first, goes deeper
  compileExpr(args[0])  // url — pushed second, on top
  → stack: [target, url] with url on top
  → ActionGetURL2 interprets: target=url, url=target (WRONG)

Fix for loadMovie: push args[0] (url) first, args[1] (target) second:
  compileExpr(args[0])  // url first (deeper)
  compileExpr(args[1])  // target second (top)

For loadMovieNum(url, level): the computed '_level'+level target string is built first (deeper) and url is pushed second (top). Same bug — the url and target are swapped. Fix: compute the level target string AFTER pushing url:
  compileExpr(args[0])  // url first
  pushString('_level'); compileExpr(args[1]); emit(ActionAdd2)  // target on top

Note: getURL(url, window) has the CORRECT order (url pushed first, window on top) since window maps to target in ActionGetURL2.

The existing test in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/loadmovie.test.ts only checks that ActionGetURL2 is emitted, not the stack layout.
